<a id="selection-through-registration--经识的选择"></a>
# Selection through registration

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`selection-through-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](selection-through-registration.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Every selection through a registration selects two histories alike exactly when they register alike. With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the registration closure; pooled registration selects an ending beyond it within reach, and a flow reaching beyond to raise what registers is selected.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A selection is any claim about level histories; it goes through a formation's registration up to a step when any two histories the formation registers alike up to that step are both selected or both not, and a score goes through it when they score alike. Registering alike is transitive, so an equivalence. (`Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough`, `Becoming.Web.ScoresThrough`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlike.trans`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo.trans`)
2. With no premise, two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's registration exactly when it registers them alike up to the step; its belief is such a selection, so where it registers them apart some selection through its registration holds at one and fails at the other. (`Becoming.Web.selects_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Web.belief_selects`, `Becoming.Web.separates`)
3. A selection through registration is refuted by its selector exactly where it fails; admission at a step up to the given one is a selection through registration, the level of an observed condition at such a step a score through it, and a score's threshold a selection through it; going through registration survives later steps, more observation, negation and conjunction. (`Becoming.Web.Refutes`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.refutes_iff`, `Becoming.Web.admits_through`, `Becoming.Web.observed_scores`, `Becoming.Web.ScoresThrough.atLeast`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.later`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.widen`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.not`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.and`)
4. Where registering alike with the first history is decidable, two histories are scored alike by every score through registration exactly when they are registered alike. (`Becoming.Web.scores_alike_iff`)
5. For a group, a selection goes through its pooled registration when histories every member registers alike are selected alike; the same equivalence and separation hold; a member's selection is a group selection, and group selections are closed under conjunction. (`Becoming.Web.SelectsThroughAll`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll.refl`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll.symm`, `Becoming.Web.RegistersAlikeAll.trans`, `Becoming.Web.selects_alike_all_iff`, `Becoming.Web.separates_all`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.all`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThroughAll.and`)
6. Blindness beyond the registration closure: with a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, balance at each step on what members of a formation's registration closure register, and every member of the part beyond that closure, every selection and score through the registration of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike, as does every group whose members lie within it. (`Becoming.Flow.WithinRegistration`, `Becoming.Flow.unregistered_beyond_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unscored_beyond_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_all`)
7. Where two flows both balance at each step on the conditions registered within the registration closure drawn through both, have the same formations present, start alike on what is registered, and members respond only through their own registration, every selection through the registration of a formation within that closure selects the two flows' levels alike. (`Becoming.Flow.RegisteredFromEither`, `Becoming.Flow.alike_within_registration`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_responsive`)
8. Share among descendants, an application of share_rises: where a selection holds for the history of every parent in one non-empty list and for none in another, the parents it holds for have at least a offspring and the others at most b, and b < a, the offspring of the first list stand to those of the second strictly more than the first list stands to the second. (`Becoming.share_rises_through`, `Becoming.share_rises`, `Becoming.offspringCount`)
9. In Clearing every selection through the clearer's registration (support only) selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step, while the dweller is ended in the first and not in the second, and that the dweller is ended goes through the clearer's registration at no step; the dweller lies within the clearer's reach closure and beyond its registration closure, and the clearer does not register the habitat. (`Becoming.Clearing.unselected`, `Becoming.Clearing.dweller_within_reach`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinReach`)
10. In Clearing the dweller's admission at the third step goes through the dweller's registration and separates the two worlds; both being admitted at the third step goes through the pooled registration of the two, separates the worlds, and goes through neither registration alone. (`Becoming.Clearing.selected_by_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.BothAdmitted`, `Becoming.Clearing.selected_pooled`)
11. In Diversion the diverting flow takes a unit from the source a dweller depends on and gives it to the store the taker observes, reaching the dweller beyond the registration closure; that the store stands at least one at the second step goes through the taker's registration, holds in the diverting flow and fails in the undiverted one. (`Becoming.Diversion.diverting`, `Becoming.Diversion.undiverted`, `Becoming.Diversion.StoreAtLeast`, `Becoming.Diversion.favours`)
12. The dweller is unsupported from the second step on in the diverting flow and supported at every step in the undiverted one; every selection through the taker's registration selects the diverting flow alike with a supplying flow that only gives to the store and reaches nothing beyond. (`Becoming.Diversion.favours`, `Becoming.Diversion.supplying`, `Becoming.Diversion.blind_to_source`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- That a selection goes through registration (Web.SelectsThrough, Web.ScoresThrough, Web.SelectsThroughAll) is a supplied condition written into each theorem that uses it, never derived; a selection is any claim about level histories.
- Blindness beyond the registration closure further assumes the conditions of unregistered_beyond_registration: the rest of the exchange fixed (a part withheld, WithheldLevels); balance assumed only on the conditions members of the registration closure register, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn); every member of the part beyond the registration closure.
- The responsive form assumes the hypotheses of alike_within_registration: both flows balanced at each step on the conditions registered, the same formations present in both flows, the same start on what is registered, members responding only through their own registration.
- The converse of the law for scores takes the decidability of registering alike with the first history as a named hypothesis (decided); the law for selections needs no decision.
- share_rises_through: the parents' histories, the lower and upper bounds on offspring (rewarded, unrewarded), b < a and both kinds of parent present are supplied; transmission is not part of it.
- For the witnesses: Clearing's flows and webs (from the modules of feeding closure, feedback and testing), and Diversion's three flows and webs.
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The laws do not derive who selects, what the selector registers, whether an actual selection goes through registration, whether offspring follow the selection, or whether reaching beyond is chosen.
- The more is registered, the larger the registration closure and the smaller the gap: the law's force lies entirely in what the selector actually registers.
- The main law is near-definitional and the blindness a one-line corollary of the theorems of testing-within-registration; the contribution is conceptual.
- The gap for one's own act (an act differing only on conditions no member of the closure registers) has no separate general theorem; in Clearing it comes from an instance of alike_within_closed.
- Favouring reaching beyond is stated only in the minimal witness Diversion. Witness: `Becoming.Diversion.favours`.
- share_rises_through is an application, and its combination with transmission and an open world is a reading; where others respond to the stock a selection rests on, the response hypotheses can fail.
- The formation of arbitrary physical primitives and more general rule-changing capture keep their own scope.
- **Counterexample:** Selection is blind to the gap: in Clearing every selection through the clearer's registration selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step, while the dweller is ended in the first and not in the second; that the dweller is ended goes through the clearer's registration at no step (Clearing.unselected). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Only pooled registration selects it: that both the dweller and the clearer are admitted at the third step goes through their pooled registration and separates the cleared from the spared world, yet goes through neither registration alone (Clearing.selected_pooled). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Selection cannot tell reaching beyond from not: in Diversion every selection through the taker's registration selects the flow diverting from the dweller's source alike with a supplying flow that only gives to the store and reaches nothing beyond, while the dweller is unsupported only in the first (Diversion.blind_to_source); the same selection selects the diverting flow over the undiverted one (Diversion.favours). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

The gap for one's own act as a general theorem: where an act differs only on conditions no member of the registration closure registers, every selection through it misses the act; favouring reaching beyond in general: when a part raising what registers must reach beyond the closure; with transmission, descent and openness (Capture's descent_needs_unrun), the rising share of what reaches beyond.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked “hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?” and pasted an explanation of causal systems of unstated authorship (neither Ren's wording nor a premise); after the AI's comparison and its five proposals, Ren wrote “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This record is the first of them. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): any selection decided by what a selector registers (keeping, rewarding, reproducing, training) reaches exactly what it registers, blind to whatever a candidate's part does beyond the selector's registration closure, however far its reach closure extends; the gap is the reach closure less the registration closure, closing only through dependence, observation or another's registration pooled; where reaching beyond raises what registers, selection favours it, and with share_rises the share of what reaches beyond rises while the world is open; for AI training, a reward process is a selector and training reaches only what the reward registers. The AI, on its own account, connects this with the title of Ren's paper “When Capability Outruns Correction”. See §86 of the integration note.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [testing-within-registration](testing-within-registration.md). Reuses Web.RegistersAlike, Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo (refl, symm, earlier, of_obs), Web.Belief, Web.Refutes (not_meets), Web.RegistersAlikeAll, Flow.WithinRegistration, Flow.withinRegistration_supportOnly, Flow.unregistered_beyond_registration, Flow.alike_within_registration, and the witness's Clearing.alike_for_clearer, tested_by_dweller, DwellerEnded, resourceGone and clearerAndDweller. The delta carries registering alike over to selection: selection through registration reaches exactly what registers, and blindness beyond the registration closure holds of every such selection.
  - Output: What registers alike; the registration closure; nothing beyond it registers; the clearer's and the dweller's testing.
  - Input: What a selection through registration can tell apart; its blindness beyond the registration closure; the witnesses of the gap.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance only on the conditions registered, at each step; the rest of the exchange fixed, or members responding only through their own registration. [Testing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [levels-of-closure](levels-of-closure.md). Reuses the closure under a relation (WithinClosure, ClosedUnder), the reach closure (Flow.WithinReach) and, in Clearing, the reach closure lying between the clearer and the whole (Clearing.reach_middle). The gap is a candidate's reach closure less the selector's registration closure.
  - Output: The reach closure; the dweller within the clearer's reach closure.
  - Input: One side of the gap: where a candidate's part reaches.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Feedback.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Feedback.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [feedback-and-reach](feedback-and-reach.md). Reuses the clearer's witness (Clearing.resource_of_clearer). There a formation's feedback registers at most its influence closure while its part reaches into its reach closure; here selection through registration also stops at the registration closure, and the gap is the difference.
  - Output: The clearer's part reaches the resource the dweller depends on.
  - Input: The witness of the gap in Clearing.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Feedback.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Feedback.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [target-capture](target-capture.md). Reuses share_rises and offspringCount. share_rises_through is an application of share_rises: the selection supplies which parents are carriers, and no arithmetic is added.
  - Output: Where each carrier leaves more offspring, the carriers' share rises among the offspring.
  - Input: The share of the parents a selection holds for rises.
  - Preserved conditions: The bounds on offspring and b < a are supplied; both kinds of parent present. [Capture.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Capture.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [runaway-distance-unregistered](runaway-distance-unregistered.md). There a policy through registration cannot use a stock it does not register; here a selection through registration cannot select on a part it does not register.
- related, not a proved adapter: [evolution-on-descent](evolution-on-descent.md). There the counting form of Price's equation leaves the selection term unstated; P62 gives the rise of a share, and here a selection through registration supplies the carriers (an application).
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-under-registration-revision](selection-under-registration-revision.md). P93 completes choice preservation/loss under registration change and local executed reconstruction; acquired recipes and general capture remain open.
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-through-a-model-of-the-options](selection-through-a-model-of-the-options.md). A law of the same form: selection through registration reaches exactly what registers, and selection through a model separates exactly what the model separates; where the model ties two options, every selection through it selects them alike.
